items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I look like they're having a good time all the time, which is not really necessarily true, like I told you about Fats Waller Fats Wallick.

ctx.x: I had heard about it, I heard people talk about it, you know in fact many people, many black people

joke about it. In fact a lot of people wonder how do black people joke about these things that have passed, you know, and how they make it, you know. They look like they're having a good time all the time, which is not really necessarily true, like I told you about Fats Waller Fats Wallick.
